definitions.explanation: Amplitude modulation radio broadcasting, which has longer range than FM but lower audio quality.

examples.japanese: AM{放送|ほうそう}を{聴|き}く。
{夜|よる}はAMの{電波|でんぱ}がよく{届|とど}く。
examples.english: AM signals travel well at night.

examples.japanese: AMラジオで{野球|やきゅう}{中継|ちゅうけい}を{聴|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to the baseball broadcast on AM radio.

notes:
AM stands for amplitude modulation ({振幅|しんぷく}{変調|へんちょう}). It has longer transmission range than FM, especially at night.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- AM{放送|ほうそう}: AM broadcasting
- AM{局|きょく}: AM station
- AMラジオ: AM radio
- AM{番組|ばんぐみ}: AM program

JAPANESE CONTEXT:
AM radio is popular for news, talk shows, and sports broadcasts. Many Japanese AM stations simulcast on FM ({ワイドFM|わいどえふえむ}) for better sound quality in urban areas.

Note: AM/PM ({午前|ごぜん}/{午後|ごご}) time notation uses the same letters but is pronounced differently.
